The '''''Vigor''''' was a [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunship]] that was used by the [[Peace Brigade]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. At some point, the ''Vigor'' and the Peace Brigade [[YV-929 armed freighter]] ''[[Blunt Force]]'' approached the refugee [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Wanderhome]]'' and [[Bunurrut]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Vigor'' contacted the ''Wanderhome'', claiming that the two ships had been ordered by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to escort the refugees aboard the ''Wanderhome'' to safety. In fact, Bunurrut planned on taking the refugees to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], and the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who had been escorting the ''Wanderhome'' managed to drive off the two Peace Brigade ships.
